summary: Phase 5 (LANE A off-platform P2P payments + transactions + admin listing fee) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed via /app/backend/tests/test_payments_phase5.py — GET/PUT /api/payments/me stores paypal_me (strips leading @), paypal_email, venmo_handle; returns paypal_connected=true and oauth_available=false; editable across saves. POST /api/payments/paypal/start returns {mode:'manual'} in fallback. Buy Now on a live listing creates Transaction status='agreed'; GET /api/transactions/mine BUYER view includes pay_targets with correct PayPal.me URL 'https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/Engine14Mike/120.00' and Venmo URL 'https://venmo.com/engine14-mike?txn=pay&amount=120.00...'; SELLER view of same tx has NO pay_targets and counterparty is public handle only (no email/name leak). Offer accept path: seller POST /offers/{id}/accept returns transaction_id, Transaction created for buyer=offer.buyer, agreed_amount=offer.amount. Completion: one-sided /complete returns status 'agreed' + waiting_on_other_party=true; both sides -> status='completed' AND listing status='sold'; can't complete a completed/cancelled tx (400). Cancel sets 'cancelled'. Admin listing-fee GET default {amount:0,active:false}; PUT updates and persists; member gets 403 on GET and PUT. Verified-only gate confirmed: unauth => 401, unverified fresh registrant => 403 on /payments/me, /transactions/mine, buy-now, tx complete/cancel. OpenAPI has no 'wallet','escrow','balance','stripe','card_number','cvv' surface; /auth/me self_user has no balance/wallet/escrow fields. Frontend: Buyer (review.emt) /profile -> payment-settings present; saving paypal_me+venmo shows 'PayPal linked ✓' (paypal-linked). 'Connect with PayPal' click in fallback mode does not redirect (correct). Marketplace -> live listing detail -> Buy Now navigates to /transactions with success toast; tx card renders pay-paypal-{id} + pay-venmo-{id} with correct href (PayPal.me/Engine14Mike/120.00 and Venmo URL with txn=pay&amount=120.00), meetup note 'Station 14 parking lot, weekday evenings', tx-complete-* and tx-cancel-* buttons. Cancel from UI transitions tx to 'cancelled' (visible on same page). Admin /admin shows listing-fee-panel with fee-amount, fee-active, fee-save-btn; setting fee=1.25 persists after save, then reset to 0.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1645 lines. Phase 5 pushed it further past the previously-flagged 700-line threshold. Auth, storage, marketplace, offers, transactions, admin, payments all still in one module — please split into routers/ before Phase 6.

payment_status() exposes 'paypal_ref' semantics only through a legacy OR check but public write path only writes paypal_me/paypal_email/venmo_handle. Recommend dropping the vestigial 'paypal_ref' field on the user document (still initialised to None in register/seed_admins) to remove dead state.

pay_targets() builds URLs by string-concatenation without URL-encoding the handle. If someone links a handle with '#' or '/' (e.g. paste from a full paypal.me link), _clean_handle strips '/' but does not urlencode. Add urllib.parse.quote for the handle segment to be safe.

Transaction cancel is allowed by EITHER party with no notification path. Consider recording who cancelled and notifying the counterparty (currently the seller cancelled the buyer's buy-now with no explicit consent flow — expected for MVP but worth flagging).

GET /api/transactions/{tx_id} lets any party fetch the tx, but the 'listing' snapshot embeds listing.photo which is a /api/files/... URL that requires require_verified — fine for members, but if a tx counterparty ever changed verification_status to non-approved they'd 403 on the photo. Consider embedding a signed URL or falling back to a placeholder.

create_transaction() is called from both buy_now and offer accept; there is NO check that a live listing does not already have an OPEN 'agreed' transaction. A seller accepting a 2nd offer on the same listing will create two agreed transactions and both buyers will be told to pay. Recommend: on accept/buy-now, if another 'agreed' transaction exists for the listing, either reject or auto-cancel the others.
No admin visibility over transactions (no /api/admin/transactions). For Trust & Safety this will be needed the moment a dispute lands.
PAYPAL_OAUTH is evaluated once at import time. If keys are later added to backend/.env you must restart backend — expected but worth documenting.

Fixture `fresh_listing` in test_payments_phase5.py is module-scoped and gets mutated by the cancel_flow test (transaction cancelled) — kept intentionally simple, but next agent should note the listing is still 'live' after the buy_now test only because of the cancel.
